question_record.context: A security incident indicated by unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app was observed. The user Luciano Herrera from the organization niseko.alpineskihouse.co performed this addition of credentials. The user added a password to the app SimulandApp, potentially indicating that the app might be compromised for malicious purposes such as phishing, data exfiltration, or gaining access to other accounts and devices. Additionally, there was a report of a malicious PowerShell Cmdlet being invoked on a machine.
question_record.question: A suspicious remote activity was observed related to this machine. Can you provide the account name associated with this remote activity?
solution: The user `Luciano Herrera` (pwilson@niseko.alpineskihouse.co) performed an unusual addition of credentials to the application `SimulandApp`, using a credential of type `Password`. This was observed on the account with SID `S-1-5-21-551436448-9871687716-9837441745-1903`.
A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked, with the process `powershell.exe` on the machine.
Suspicious remote activity was observed, initiated by the account `LocalSystem`.

108.name: Unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app
108.description: The user Luciano Herrera (pwilson@niseko.alpineskihouse.co) performed an unusual addition of credentials to the application SimulandApp. This usage pattern may indicate that an attacker has compromised the app, and is using it to spread phishing, exfiltrate data, or to gain access to other accounts and devices. The user added a credential of type Password. A credential of type Password is added when an application is using a password to authenticate.

51.name: A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine
51.description: A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine. The Cmdlet may be associated with credential theft, exploitation, network reconnaissance or code injection.

37.name: Suspicious remote activity
37.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.

steps.sql:

       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_Derived_Email' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
